newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle weak to $0.50 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle weak to $0.50 lower - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were weak to $0.50 per cwt lower, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest moderate. Offerings current.
